turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
t simple: loosen the top layer of soil, scatter the seed evenly, press it into the soil, and keep the area lightly watered while it germinates.

The easiest way to get even coverage is to measure your planting area, divide the seed into four equal piles, then spread one pile in each pass: first in one direction, then perpendicular, then repeat both directions once more. If you want, I can also help you figure out how much seed you need for your space.
